description: This file defines the Cart controller class for the Opencart system, handling cart operations such as displaying the cart, removing products and vouchers, and generating the cart view.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class managing shopping cart operations in the Opencart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shopping cart view, including products, totals, vouchers, and other cart-related information.

methods.name: removeProduct
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart via AJAX request and returns JSON response.

methods.name: removeVoucher
methods.description: Removes a voucher from the cart via AJAX request and returns JSON response.
